VIA1.accuracy_risk: HIGH (corroborated: 2603.18940, 2506.04210, 2507.14417). Hard monotone thresholds forbid tightening after a confidence collapse — removes the very CMC 'not actively declining' flexibility behind AutoTTS's best accuracy/compute tradeoff.

VIA2.competitive_vs_baselines: Real but narrow gap; added value limited to formal verifiability, not improved accuracy/efficiency. AutoTTS's CMC EMA trend-gating handles confidence collapses better than a hard invariant would.
VIA2.accuracy_risk: HIGH (EDIS 2602.01288; entropy-trajectory 2603.18940). Reasoning trajectories are empirically non-monotone in confidence; a hard non-decreasing threshold structurally mishandles mid-trajectory collapse.

ev_gate_application: Value MODEST_INCREMENTAL < promote-threshold SIGNIFICANT -> default SEED_ONLY. Exact combo NOT done -> not NOT_VIABLE. Accuracy risk HIGH caps upside but is scope-resolvable -> not NOT_VIABLE. Both agents independently landed SEED_ONLY.
